// rootDir: Set to the package root (not src) so the generated auth-schema.ts — which lives at the root for drizzle-kit to scan — is inside rootDir when src/store/schema.ts re-exports it. Typecheck runs --noEmit; the real build is driven by tsdown's own entry points (src/cli.ts, src/index.ts), so this rootDir only bounds type-checking, not emit layout.
// lib: DOM is needed because @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's transport .d.ts references fetch globals (HeadersInit). The MCP server itself is server-only at runtime (HTTP transport, no browser APIs).
// skipLibCheck: Scoped override of the repo's base skipLibCheck:false. Two unavoidable third-party .d.ts do not compile under the repo's strict exactOptionalPropertyTypes: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's StreamableHTTPServerTransport (its own class-implements-Transport onclose typing) and pino→thread-stream (worker_threads.TransferListItem). Our own sources are still fully type-checked.
